milestones.title: New $5 issued
milestones.detail: First of the Next Generation Banknote series, with a top-to-bottom clear window and tactile features.

milestones.title: New $100 issued
milestones.detail: Completes the Next Generation Banknote series.

milestones.title: Decision to redesign the $5
milestones.detail: The Board decided the new $5 will honour the culture and history of First Australians, replacing the portrait of Queen Elizabeth II. The current $5 remains legal tender.

milestones.title: 'Reimagine the $5' public campaign
milestones.detail: Australians invited to suggest themes (closed 30 April 2024), alongside engagement with First Nations organisations in every state and territory.

milestones.title: Theme announced: Connection to Country
milestones.detail: Chosen from more than 2,100 public nominations by the $5 Redesign Imagery Selection Panel. The design will feature artwork by a First Nations artist.

milestones.title: Artwork selection and design reveal
milestones.detail: Date to be announced by the RBA.

milestones.title: New $5 enters circulation
milestones.detail: The RBA has said the note will take a number of years to design and print; date to be announced.
